src/auth/anthropic-oauth.js.label: no-chat-text
src/auth/anthropic-oauth.js.why: the Anthropic OAuth token exchange and refresh: credentials only, never a chat's text

src/browser/playwright-browser.js.label: tool
src/browser/playwright-browser.js.why: the browser tools' Playwright driver; browsing is a tool and behaves as now (R-LI-9)

src/cases/contact-host.js.label: transport
src/cases/contact-host.js.why: hands fetch to the contact channels that carry a case's questions to the owner and the answers back; not a model call

src/cases/executors/package-loader.js.label: transport
src/cases/executors/package-loader.js.why: an external executor's host.fetch: it sends a job's gated payload to the executor the owner's envelope names (R-LI-24); not a model call

src/cases/ingest/pdf-worker.js.label: no-chat-text
src/cases/ingest/pdf-worker.js.why: the PDF worker writes its framed results to its parent process on fd 3: a pipe on this machine, no network

src/channels/discord-bridge.js.label: transport
src/channels/discord-bridge.js.why: the Discord bridge: a bridge chat's text passes through Discord by design, and a bridge chat cannot be marked private (spec §8.2; refused in Task 14)

src/channels/email-transports.js.label: transport
src/channels/email-transports.js.why: SMTP and IMAP for the email contact channel: case questions to the owner's own address and the replies; not a model call

src/channels/relay-client.js.label: transport
src/channels/relay-client.js.why: the SMS and voice relay for the contact ladder: questions to the owner's own number; not a model call

src/channels/slack-bridge.js.label: transport
src/channels/slack-bridge.js.why: the Slack channel bridge: its text passes through Slack by design; it runs on a session, never on a history chat that could be marked

src/channels/telegram-bridge.js.label: transport
src/channels/telegram-bridge.js.why: the Telegram bridge, its voice replies included: a bridge chat's text passes through Telegram by design and it cannot be marked private (spec §8.2; refused in Task 14)

src/context/context-assembler.js.label: gated
src/context/context-assembler.js.why: semantic tool selection embeds the owner's message through a direct OpenAI client; assemble({ embed: false }) skips it and the chat send path passes that under a policy. index() embeds tool descriptions only

src/core/create-core.js.label: gated
src/core/create-core.js.why: builds every provider instance and the router: snapshotModels freezes the chat's policy, resolveRole hands out the routed provider under one, and each tool executor is given the run's policy

src/desktop-bridge/bridge-client.js.label: transport
src/desktop-bridge/bridge-client.js.why: the attached desktop's WebSocket to the service on 127.0.0.1; the turn and its model calls run in the service, under the service's marks (spec §8.7)

src/desktop-bridge/bridge-server.js.label: transport
src/desktop-bridge/bridge-server.js.why: the service's loopback listener for a paired desktop (127.0.0.1 only); it carries IPC, and makes no model call

src/execution/agent-loop.js.label: gated
src/execution/agent-loop.js.why: semantic compaction embeds the query and old tool results through the embedding provider it was handed; given an egress policy the loop takes no provider, and the chat send path hands it none

src/fleet/doctor-checks.js.label: no-chat-text
src/fleet/doctor-checks.js.why: doctor's TLS reachability check of the relay or front door: a handshake, no text

src/frontdoor/doctor-checks.js.label: no-chat-text
src/frontdoor/doctor-checks.js.why: the front door's doctor checks its own listener over https; a front door runs no chat

src/frontdoor/oauth/cimd.js.label: no-chat-text
src/frontdoor/oauth/cimd.js.why: fetches an OAuth client's metadata document for the front door; a front door runs no chat

src/frontdoor/probe.js.label: no-chat-text
src/frontdoor/probe.js.why: the front door's self-probe of its own names and certificate; no text of any chat

src/frontdoor/push/apns.js.label: transport
src/frontdoor/push/apns.js.why: pushes an approval or question notice to the owner's enrolled phone through APNs from the relay; not a model call

src/frontdoor/tls/acme.js.label: no-chat-text
src/frontdoor/tls/acme.js.why: the front door's ACME certificate orders; no text of any chat

src/gateway/gateway-server.js.label: transport
src/gateway/gateway-server.js.why: the local gateway's WebSocket server on 127.0.0.1 for sessions; a session belongs to no chat and has no mark (spec §7.1)

src/history/embed-indexer.js.label: behind-gate
src/history/embed-indexer.js.why: hands each embedder only the chunks the store's pending query returns: no private or imported chat's chunk for a key that is not local:, and those chunks to the keep-local embedder

src/history/embed-worker.js.label: no-chat-text
src/history/embed-worker.js.why: the embed worker, a child process on this machine: it runs the local embedder and cross-encoder and answers its parent on fd 3; it downloads model files and sends no text

src/history/embedders/local-backend.js.label: no-chat-text
src/history/embedders/local-backend.js.why: loads the local models inside the embed worker; the only request is the one-time download of model files

src/history/embedders/local.js.label: no-chat-text
src/history/embedders/local.js.why: hands text to the embed worker, a child process on this machine; nothing leaves it

src/history/embedders/remote.js.label: behind-gate
src/history/embedders/remote.js.why: the hosted and Ollama embedder: it embeds what the indexer hands it (never a private or imported chat's chunk) and a query vector-search.js hands it (never a private chat's)

src/history/vector-search.js.label: gated
src/history/vector-search.js.why: embeds a turn's query with the active embedder, except with a private chat in scope: then only with the local embedder, or not at all (vectorsSkipped private-chat)

src/ipc/memory-handlers.js.label: no-chat-text
src/ipc/memory-handlers.js.why: the Memory pane's own form; no chat turn calls capture

src/ipc/settings-handlers.js.label: no-chat-text
src/ipc/settings-handlers.js.why: connection tests for the search and image keys, with a fixed test query; no text of any chat

src/media/image-generation/fal-provider..label: behind-gate
src/media/image-generation/fal-provider..why: an image client built only by the ImageGenerate tool, which refuses under a policy before it builds one (R-LI-33)

src/media/image-generation/openai-provid.label: behind-gate
src/media/image-generation/openai-provid.why: an image client built only by the ImageGenerate tool, which refuses under a policy before it builds one (R-LI-33)

src/media/image-handler.js.label: no-chat-text
src/media/image-handler.js.why: downloads an image the owner attached by URL: a GET of that URL, with nothing of the chat in it

src/memory/embedding-provider.js.label: behind-gate
src/memory/embedding-provider.js.why: the direct OpenAI embeddings client; only the context assembler builds one, and it and the agent loop do not call it under a policy

src/memory/memory-manager.js.label: no-chat-text
src/memory/memory-manager.js.why: the Memory pane's own form; no chat turn calls capture, and it embeds only with a provider the core never gives it (both pinned in tests/egress-inventory.test.js)

src/memory/memory-retrieval.js.label: no-chat-text
src/memory/memory-retrieval.js.why: embeds a query only with a provider it is handed, and the core hands memory none (pinned in tests/egress-inventory.test.js)

src/mesh/mesh-discovery.js.label: no-chat-text
src/mesh/mesh-discovery.js.why: announces and finds mesh peers on the local network (mDNS); no text of any chat

src/mesh/mesh-pairing.js.label: no-chat-text
src/mesh/mesh-pairing.js.why: the mesh pairing handshake between the owner's machines: keys and codes, no text of any chat

src/mesh/mesh-transport.js.label: transport
src/mesh/mesh-transport.js.why: links to the owner's other machines; the tool that sends a task over them (RemoteDispatch) is refused in a private chat (src/tools/private-refusals.js)

src/models/availability.js.label: no-chat-text
src/models/availability.js.why: provider connection tests: a model list request with the key, no text of any chat; a private turn's filtered candidates name no hosted provider to test

src/models/catalog.js.label: no-chat-text
src/models/catalog.js.why: the catalog refresh from models.dev and OpenRouter; no text of any chat

src/models/local-servers.js.label: behind-gate
src/models/local-servers.js.why: builds each local server's provider on its pinned transport; its isGuaranteeTarget is what the resolver and the router ask under a policy

src/models/local-transport.js.label: behind-gate
src/models/local-transport.js.why: the only module that dials a local server, and only its pinned address: this is where a private chat's text is allowed to go

src/models/ollama.js.label: no-chat-text
src/models/ollama.js.why: lists the built-in Ollama provider's models; no text of any chat

src/notifications/channels/ntfy-channel..label: transport
src/notifications/channels/ntfy-channel..why: task and question notices to the owner's own ntfy topic; delivery only, not a model call

src/providers/base-provider.js.label: gated
src/providers/base-provider.js.why: every provider request passes request(), which refuses under an egress policy unless the provider's transport is guarantee grade

src/providers/local-server-provider.js.label: behind-gate
src/providers/local-server-provider.js.why: a local server's provider: every call, embed included, goes through request() on the server's pinned transport

src/providers/provider-factory.js.label: behind-gate
src/providers/provider-factory.js.why: builds the 14 hosted providers; each sends only through request(), which refuses under a policy, and local is not registered here

src/service/commands/pair-front-door.js.label: no-chat-text
src/service/commands/pair-front-door.js.why: the administrator's pairing request to the front door: a code and an identity, no text of any chat

src/session/connection.js.label: no-chat-text
src/session/connection.js.why: the session helper's local socket to the service on the same machine (fleet stage 5); nothing leaves the machine

src/tools/builtin/image-generate-tool.js.label: gated
src/tools/builtin/image-generate-tool.js.why: refuses PRIVATE_HOSTED_CALL under an egress policy before any image client is built (R-LI-33)

src/tools/builtin/web-fetch-tool.js.label: tool
src/tools/builtin/web-fetch-tool.js.why: WebFetch fetches the URL the model asks for; tools behave as now (R-LI-9)

src/voice/engines/elevenlabs.js.label: behind-gate
src/voice/engines/elevenlabs.js.why: the hosted read-aloud engine: a chat's read-aloud asks for the system engine under a policy (R-LI-33); its other callers are agent-panel runs and bridge chats, which are never private

src/web-search/providers/brave-search.js.label: tool
src/web-search/providers/brave-search.js.why: WebSearch sends its query to the search provider; tools behave as now (R-LI-9)

src/web-search/providers/duckduckgo.js.label: tool
src/web-search/providers/duckduckgo.js.why: WebSearch sends its query to the search provider; tools behave as now (R-LI-9)

src/web-search/providers/tavily.js.label: tool
src/web-search/providers/tavily.js.why: WebSearch sends its query to the search provider; tools behave as now (R-LI-9)
